source.note: 1991 Topps is one 792-card base checklist. VCS collapses TCDB's numerous error/correction, print, and copyright variations to one canonical card per printed number so completion remains a true 792-card base set. The 33-card 1990 Rookies Commemorative Set (Glossy Rookies) is modeled as the normal collectible pack insert based on checklist/insertion-ratio references describing one per 100-card Jumbo pack. Glossy All-Stars (mail-in), Collector's Edition (Tiffany), Desert Shield, Instant Win game pieces, anniversary buyback/game promotions, pre-production material, and wax-box-bottom cards are excluded from the standard VCS pack pool.

decisions.variationHandling: All source error/correction, print, copyright, and letter-suffixed variants for a printed base number collapse to one canonical VCS card. Error/correction detail is intentionally omitted from Player and Variant.
decisions.trueRookieHandling: RC is appended only to base cards independently verified by the TCDB rookie index. The word Rookies in the Glossy Rookies insert name does not make those insert cards true rookie cards.
decisions.packChannelAbstraction: VCS uses one universal 4-card pack. The Glossy Rookies insert was distributed one per 100-card Jumbo pack; normalizing by card volume yields one Glossy Rookie per 25 VCS 4-card packs.

normalizedInsertOdds.glossyRookies: 1 per 100-card Jumbo pack -> 1 per 25 VCS 4-card packs -> stored as 1:25

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: One canonical VCS card per printed number 1-792, equally weighted. True RC labels come only from the linked rookie index. ERR/COR/UER/VAR and printer/copyright variation detail is not shown in Player or Variant.

productSets.name: Glossy Rookies
productSets.notes: 33-card insert checklist. Distributed one per 100-card Jumbo pack; normalized by card volume to 1:25 in the VCS universal 4-card pack. Insert subjects are not labeled RC solely because the set is named Glossy Rookies.
